correctness.rationale: For right-Leibniz bracket [e_i,e_1]=e_{i+1}, 2<=i<=n−1, derivations preserve W=span(e2,...,en) and satisfy D(e1)=a e1+b en, D|W=aH+f(N), where H has diagonal 0,...,n−2, N is a full Jordan shift, [H,N]=N. Triangular idempotent diagonal forces a=0 unless char2; a=0 gives local-polynomial idempotents f=0 or 1 with a zero map and A1 of rank n−1. In char2 and a=1, odd f coefficients are free, even coefficients c_{2j}=c_j² and c0∈{0,1}; first-column equation forces b=0 in one branch, free in the other. This gives four reduced affine components A0,A1,A^s,A^{s+1} and rank polynomial 1+qT^{n−1}+q^{s+1}T^{s+1}+q^sT^{t+1} for q even, with s=floor((n−1)/2),t=ceil((n−1)/2); odd q has 1+qT^{n−1}. Independently exhausted all 2^16 matrices for (n,q)=(4,2): 32 derivations, 9 projections with rank counts 0:1, 2:4, 3:4. This corroborates rather than substitutes symbolic arbitrary-field proof.

evidence: Complex NGF_1 derivation descriptions have broader n but fixed char0 and no polynomial idempotency condition; they cannot imply the characteristic-two components. General abelian grading classifications in characteristic zero similarly omit modular rank counts.
